notes: Simpson MegaShot MSH3125 gas pressure washer with a Honda GC190 engine. The drawing lists a different pump part for serials 101225 to 710889 and for serials from 715754, so check the serial before matching pump parts.

gaps: Pump rating conflict: the drawing's pump table says 3100 PSI at 2.4 GPM from serial 715754 (3000 PSI on serials 101225 to 710889; its title block says 2.5 GPM), the product sheet says 3200 PSI at 2.5 GPM, the manual says 3100 PSI and 2.5 GPM maximum. Each figure stays with its own source.
The drawing's pump table does not list serials 710890 to 715753.
Pump make and type: the drawing says horizontal axial brass pump; the product sheet says OEM Technologies axial cam pump. Both are kept as separate attributed claims.
The drawing copy has 4 of its 9 sheets (item list and pump table on sheet 1); sheets 5 to 9 were not available.
Unloader: the drawing lists only an unloader cover cap (item 5.2), not the unloader valve, so only the cap is claimed.
Wheels: the product sheet says 10 in pneumatic tyres; the drawing shows 4 x 10 in wheels with 5/8 in bearings and does not say pneumatic.
Engine: the drawing and product sheet name the Honda GC190. The Honda GC brochure covers the whole GC series, so only its GC190 fuel tank figure is used; no engine manual was read.
The 4500 PSI at 6.6 GPM figure is the gun's own rating, not the pump's.
The product sheet's 24 x 21 x 24 in size and 66 lb are for the whole washer, not the frame.
No detergent tank is claimed: the item list has only a soap hose and filter kit.
No pump oil is claimed: the manual says the pump was filled at the factory and is maintenance free.
No production years are set: the manual is Rev. 1, January 2012 and the drawing is dated 2014.
method: Simpson parts drawing 60551-S Rev B (FNA-Group title block, ECN DC14-0117, 2014), copy on apw-inc.com (a parts retailer): sheet 1 item list and pump table, sheet 3 pump kit, sheet 4 gun, lance, hose and soap kit; sheet 1 also rendered and read.
Simpson MSH3125 product sheet, part 60551 (simpsoncleaning.com PDF): ratings, engine, pump, hose, tyres, frame, size and weight.
Simpson MSH3125 instruction manual, part 7104573 Rev. 1 JAN 2012 (Home Depot document server copy): thermal relief valve, pump and engine oil notes, fuel fill level. Spanish text not used.
Honda GC series engines brochure (Honda Power Equipment PDF), page 5: GC190 fuel tank capacity.
simpsoncleaning.com's MSH3125 page links no manual or parts list, so the retailer and Home Depot copies were used.

comps.spec: Honda GC190 engine as a service assembly, part 7106183 (drawing item 3, qty 1); the product sheet also names the Honda GC190
Pump named in the product sheet as an OEM Technologies axial cam pump, described there as maintenance free with thermal relief; the sheet gives the unit 3200 PSI and 2.5 GPM

Pump service kit 7106161 (drawing item 5) holding pump 520002 (item 5.1), horizontal axial, brass, listed as 3100 PSI at 2.4 GPM. The drawing's pump table: serials 715754 on use pump 520002 in kit 7106161; serials 101225 to 710889 use a 3000 PSI at 2.4 GPM pump, part 7106161 in kit 7104979
Thermal relief valve on the pump; the manual says it opens to release water when the pump temperature rises too high, then closes again
Unloader cover cap only, black, 1 1/2 x 5/8 in, in the pump service kit (drawing item 5.2, marked not sold separately)
Spray gun with trigger, M22 (male) x M22 (female), marked 4500 PSI at 6.6 GPM, part 7106275 (drawing item 12, qty 1)
MorFlex high-pressure hose, 1/4 in x 25 ft, marked 3100 PSI, M22 (male) x M22 (female), part 7106419 (drawing item 14)
Nozzle set, 5 pieces, 1/4 in QC-M (quick-connect male), part 7103743 (drawing item 11)
Soap hose and filter kit, part 7102037 (drawing item 15)
16 in spray lance, 1/4 in QC-F (quick-connect female) x M22 (male), part 7103550 (drawing item 13)
Wheel service kit 7105013 (drawing item 6): two black 4 x 10 in wheels with 5/8 in bearings (items 6.1, qty 2), plus two flat washers and two E-type clips (items 6.2 and 6.3)
Welded steel frame with a powder-coated finish (product sheet); the sheet gives the whole washer as 24 x 21 x 24 in and 66 lb
Frame base with labels, part 7107894 (drawing item 1)
Petrol in the engine tank: the manual says to fill to no more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) below the bottom of the filler neck
Fuel tank of the Honda GC190 engine, 1.9 US qt (1.8 L), from Honda's general GC series brochure; the drawing and product sheet name the GC190 as this unit's engine
Engine ships without oil, and the manual says to add the oil supplied before starting. The pump comes filled with oil from the factory and the manual calls it maintenance free, needing no oil
